name: Troy Bray
prior_offices: Park County Republican Party precinct committeeman
background: A Powell resident and Park County GOP precinct committeeman, he filed for HD25 after Rep. Dan Laursen decided to run for Senate. Cowboy State Daily reported he had also run unsuccessfully for Natrona County commissioner in 2012 and 2014. Those 2022 profiles also discussed a September 2021 profane email to Sen. Tara Nethercott for which he later apologized for the language but not the sentiment; that episode is noted here only as contemporary campaign context reported by those papers.
